package main

// leavingQuit handles QUIT. Disconnect (running_synth.go) removes the client
// from the nick table and every channel, tells channel peers once, and closes
// the queue so the writer flushes the ERROR line before closing the connection.
// The read loop sees the client is gone and stops; its final Disconnect is a no-op.
func leavingQuit(s *Server, c *Client, m Message) {
	reason := "Client quit"
	if len(m.Params) > 0 {
		reason = m.Params[0]
	}
	c.Send("ERROR :Closing link")
	s.Disconnect(c, reason)
}

func leavingInitBody() {
	handlers["QUIT"] = leavingQuit
	// A connection that drops without QUIT is handled by serve in running_synth.go,
	// which calls Disconnect with "Connection closed".
}
